exposure: Expression of 14 steroid genes in abdominal subcutaneous adipose tissue
outcome: Association between fatty acid profiles and expression of steroid genes
cohort: 36 non-PCOS pregnant women and 12 pregnant women with PCOS undergoing cesarean section
finding: Omega-3 fatty acids, particularly eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA), were associated with the expression of steroidogenic acute regulator (STAR), a key gene in steroidogenesis, in the subcutaneous adipose tissue of pregnant women, especially those without PCOS.
